meta.name: Chili Local Workbench
meta.description: A calm, warm-graphite desktop workbench for a local coding agent, with pepper-red heat signals and a dedicated multi-agent activity surface.
source_references: ChatGPT desktop interaction patterns: quiet conversation canvas, lightweight user bubbles, anchored composer

primary.role: primary actions, running heat, focus and selected-task accents

secondary.role: healthy local runtime and successful work

accent.role: quiet links, inline code and secondary warm emphasis

neutral.usage: Deep canvas at 0-1, panels at 2-4, metadata at 5-6, body and headings at 7-8.

color.contrast_strategy: High-contrast reading surface with quiet alpha hairlines; saturated color is reserved for state and action.

font_families.heading: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, SF Pro Display, Segoe UI, sans-serif
font_families.body: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, SF Pro Text, Segoe UI, sans-serif

typography.font_style_notes: Native humanist sans for a Mac-like reading feel; monospaced type is limited to code, paths, diffs and shortcuts.

spacing.section_rhythm: 8px panel gutters, 20px timeline rhythm, 24-32px content breathing room and compact 40-52px navigation rows.

layout.grid_system: Three-surface workbench with independently collapsible 260px task rail, fluid conversation and 316px activity inspector.
layout.alignment_tendency: strict workbench grid with centered reading content

shape.border_usage: 0.5-1px alpha hairlines on primary surfaces and inputs; content remains mostly borderless.

elevation.depth_cues: deep canvas, raised panels, alpha borders, restrained blur and localized warm glows

iconography.style: minimal rounded outline with a filled custom pepper mark
iconography.preferred_set: custom inline SVG icons and the Chili pepper brand mark

motion.exit_pattern: short fade followed by visibility collapse
motion.philosophy: minimal functional motion with reduced-motion fallback

components.button_style: Quiet neutral controls; pepper-red circular send and branded primary CTA; minimum 30-38px targets.
components.input_style: 18px floating composer with warm raised surface, alpha border and restrained focus glow.
components.card_style: Cards only for meaningful surfaces, requests and root activity; assistant content stays document-like.
components.navigation_pattern: Collapsible recent-task rail with a persistent local-workspace footer.
components.modal_style: Raised warm-graphite surface with high shadow and semantic border.
components.list_style: 52px task rows with quiet icons, relative time and a pepper heat dot for the selection.
components.component_notes: The Workbench is Chili-specific: activity and repository changes share an on-demand right surface. Conversation hierarchy is always user bubble → one Worked/Working disclosure → final answer. Successful tools never appear as first-class transcript cards; tool output and diagnostic detail remain collapsed until the user explicitly opens them.

aesthetic.visual_metaphor: a quiet local workshop with visible heat where work is active

visual_language.whitespace_usage: generous in the conversation, compact in navigation and telemetry
visual_language.focal_strategy: composer and current assistant response first; activity color appears only where state changes
visual_language.contrast_level: high for content, restrained for chrome
visual_language.texture_usage: soft radial warmth, alpha hairlines and nearly flat graphite surfaces

composition.hierarchy_method: spatial isolation, typographic hierarchy and semantic heat color
composition.balance_type: asymmetric workbench anchored by a fluid center
composition.flow_direction: left task selection to center collaboration to right evidence
composition.grouping_strategy: panel-level grouping with mostly borderless content inside
composition.negative_space_role: protects reading focus and separates assistant reasoning from operational telemetry

imagery.photo_treatment: not used in core product UI
imagery.illustration_style: single custom pepper mark with bold simple geometry
imagery.graphic_elements: pepper heat dots, warm radial glows and semantic status rings
imagery.image_shape: rounded attachment tiles when image rendering becomes available

interaction_feel.feedback_style: immediate color and surface feedback with explicit status copy
interaction_feel.hover_behavior: small warm surface lift without scale theatrics
interaction_feel.loading_style: semantic pulsing state dots and stable layout

brand_voice_in_ui.empty_state_approach: outcome-oriented invitation with a clear next action

overview.fallback_strategy: reduce to static CSS and disable transitions

background_effects.description: Static localized warm radial gradients over a deep graphite canvas.

params.density: one to two focal gradients per surface

particle_systems.description: No particles; operational focus takes priority.

text_effects.description: Typography remains stable for long-session readability.

svg_animations.description: The pepper logo is a static inline SVG.

visual_effects.composite_notes: Warm radial CSS gradients, a frosted titlebar, alpha hairlines and small semantic pulse dots provide depth without Canvas, WebGL or distracting ambient animation. All motion is disabled by prefers-reduced-motion.
